description:
Job Purpose Develop reliable robotics software and firmware that connect onboard computers, microcontrollers, sensors and actuators. Own assigned modules from design and implementation through integration, testing and technical documentation. Key Responsibilities - Develop C++ ROS 2 nodes, interfaces, actions and lifecycle-managed components for ROV systems and payload automation. - Write embedded C/C++ for microcontrollers, peripheral interfaces, actuator control, watchdogs and local fault handling. - Use Python for test automation, hardware simulation, diagnostics and engineering utilities. - Define hardware and software interfaces; integrate sensors and actuators over CAN, UART, SPI, I2C or Ethernet as applicable. - Implement interlocks, timeouts, command validation and safe recovery; debug failures across firmware, communications and ROS 2. - Maintain reviewed code, reproducible builds, test evidence and documentation; support bench integration and supervised vehicle trials. Required Qualifications and Experience 1-3 years of hands-on experience in robotics software, embedded firmware or closely related engineering. Bachelor s degree in Robotics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated practical experience. Candidates should be able to explain code they have built, integrated and debugged. Underwater robotics experience is preferred. Skills and Competencies Must-have technical skills - C++: object-oriented design, ownership and memory management, state machines, concurrency and debugging. - Python: scripts, automated tests, data handling and simulation of hardware interfaces. - ROS 2: packages, topics, services, actions, parameters, launch files, lifecycle nodes, executors and basic QoS. - Embedded programming: microcontrollers, GPIO, timers, interrupts, PWM, serial interfaces, watchdogs and safe startup behavior. - Linux, Git, CMake and colcon; ability to diagnose timing, communication and integration faults. Preferred: STM32/ESP32 or equivalent, RTOS fundamentals, CAN, bench debugging with a logic analyzer or oscilloscope, and software/hardware-in-the-loop testing. Behavioral competencies: structured problem solving, clear communication, ownership, careful documentation and collaboration with mechanical, electronics and testing teams.

title: Manager – Sanctions Model Validation
description:
Job Summary 
 As part of our Risk Consulting FS team, we are looking for a Manager with strong consulting and technical skills to join the FS Risk team and to work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects within the financial services sector across MENA region. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst strongly contributing to the growth of Risk Consulting FS domain service offerings and solutions thus creating authentic customer experiences. The opportunity 
 As a manager, you will engage with clients to validate and enhance sanctions screening and transaction monitoring models, ensuring they are finely tuned to meet regulatory standards and operational needs. You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams leading engagements and play a key role in ensuring high quality outputs and service to our clients. You will oversee the validation and fine-tuning of models/ tools used for sanctions screening and transaction monitoring. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, enhancing model performance, developing knowledge and implementing new solutions in order to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients. Your key responsibilities 
 Build a team of Seniors and Analysts to drive the model validation related activities. Lead and oversee sanction screening and transaction monitoring model validation engagements including rule-based systems anomaly detection and machine learning algorithms. Develop and implement strategies for model fine-tuning and performance enhancement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate model outputs into business processes. Provide training and guidance to team members on model validation processes and best practices. Conduct regular reviews (both qualitative and quantitative analysis) and audits of model performance and compliance. Lead the development of reports on model performance and validation outcomes and present to senior management on an on-going basis. Prepare detailed validation reports and documentation for regulatory bodies and internal stakeholders. Develop, implement and continuously improve the validation frameworks including back-testing, threshold setting and performance metrics. Stay abreast of regulatory changes and advancements in model validation techniques. Lead multiple assignments and related initiatives. Develop strong working relationships with the client and onshore client teams. Good to have experience in Risk Management or other Risk Consulting engagements. The job would require travel (Over 50%) to client locations in Middle East and North Africa such as Dubai, Kuwait, Riyadh, Doha etc. Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers. Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development. 

 Skills and attributes for success 
 Proficient in SQL and Python. Familiarity with database management and data analysis tools. Experience in system implementation/fine-tuning, cloud deployment and project management. Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) regulations and screening tools. Exceptional command over spoken and written English.
